cds.title: Texas Woman's University Common Data Set 2025-2026 (PDF)

ipeds.title: IPEDS College Navigator (profile, student-to-faculty ratio, programs, fall 2024)

stats.notes: CDS C1 (fall 2025 first-year class): 7,804 applied, 7,536 admitted, 1,502 enrolled. The in-state / out-of-state / international split in C1 was left blank, so international applicants and admits are not published. Undergraduate enrollment 9,962 and nonresident undergraduates 161 are the CDS B1/B2 'Total Undergraduates' figures; the student-to-faculty ratio (16:1) is the fall 2024 College Navigator figure. TWU is coeducational but 8,790 of its 9,962 undergraduates are women. No waiting list, early decision or early action. TWU is test-optional, so SAT percentiles describe the 48% (SAT) and 8% (ACT) of enrollees who submitted scores; no ACT percentiles were reported. The PDF header says 'Common Data Set 2024-2025' but its data are for fall 2025 and it is posted as the 2025-2026 edition. CDS C7 factor checkboxes could not be read from the PDF text, so no factors are recorded.

cds_test_policy.notes: CDS C8F: 'TWU is test-optional. Scores should be submitted if a student is using their scores to claim a TSI exemption.'

cost.notes: CDS G1 (first-year): nonresident tuition $19,980, required fees $3,850, on-campus food and housing $13,230 (the form's G1 text asks for 2026-27 costs; the filing does not say otherwise). H6: institutional need-based and non-need-based aid are both available to nonresident undergraduates; 55 received it (average $6,683, total $240,274).
